question: For a fixed q_ab=a^2 gamma_ab, does the matter-only bracket {D_phi[v],H_phi[N]} equal H_phi[L_v N], and how much of the observed difference is the omitted metric-strain variation rather than a cutoff effect?
one_output: An exact L=2,3 decomposition into lapse transport, fixed-metric strain residual, and finite projection remainder for one nonzero zonal packet.
non_claims: the full hypersurface-deformation algebra or Jacobi identity
BFV/BRST nilpotency or a physical prediction

primary_sources.source: R. Arnowitt, S. Deser and C. W. Misner, The Dynamics of General Relativity
primary_sources.used_for: the canonical gravity setting in which metric and matter parts jointly generate spatial diffeomorphisms
primary_sources.not_used_for: an executable proof of the selected finite S3 coefficient identity

primary_sources.source: T. Thiemann, Introduction to Modern Canonical Quantum General Relativity
primary_sources.used_for: the continuum DH reference relation {D[v],H[N]}=H[L_v N] for the combined constraints
primary_sources.not_used_for: permission to omit the gravitational metric generator

primary_sources.source: L. Lindblom, N. W. Taylor and F. Zhang, Scalar, Vector and Tensor Harmonics on the Three-Sphere
primary_sources.used_for: S3 Laplace-eigenfunction, normalization and exceptional-mode convention checks
primary_sources.not_used_for: a complete Gaunt ledger or this DH calculation

reused_local_implementation.used_for: the already checked normalized zonal product, gradient-Gaunt, direct-integration, Hamiltonian and Poisson helpers
reused_local_implementation.not_used_for: the DH result or its interpretation

declared_conventions.geometry: unit round S3 with Vol=2*pi^2, Q_n=U_n(cos chi)/sqrt(2*pi^2), Delta Q_n=-n(n+2)Q_n and q_ab=a^2 gamma_ab
declared_conventions.canonical_fields: phi=sum theta_n Q_n, pi_phi=sqrt(gamma) sum xi_n Q_n, and {theta_i,xi_j}=delta_ij
declared_conventions.matter_constraints: H_phi[N]=(1/2) integral sqrt(gamma) N[a^(-3)xi^2+a|D theta|^2] and D_phi[v]=integral sqrt(gamma) xi v^a D_a theta
declared_conventions.bracket_order: The tested order is {D_phi[v],H_phi[N]}; with the stated canonical sign, the continuum combined-constraint target is +H_phi[L_v N].
declared_conventions.fixed_metric_boundary: The canonical bracket varies theta and xi but not q_ab. For a non-Killing v, any strain residual is an omitted-metric diagnostic, not an HDA anomaly.
declared_conventions.projection_boundary: Ambient-before-project and L-only brackets are distinct; their difference is reported separately from the fixed-metric residual.

packet.selection_reason: The pure theta=Q2, xi=Q1 packet is parity-protected zero=zero; Q1+Q2 mixes parities so both lapse transport and fixed-metric strain can be tested nontrivially.

controls: independent direct chi integration of both lapse transport and the fixed-metric divergence/Hessian strain term
ambient-channel decomposition of the L-only projection remainder
